witness_description: In the two-element chain A={0,1} with id_A(x)=x and suprema given by maxima, take X={0}; id_A(sup A)=1 while sup{id_A(x) : x in X}=0.
refutation_explanation: The claim quantifies over every subset X of A, so the concrete nonempty subset X={0} suffices to refute it: the asserted equality reads 1=0.
search_space: All 26 nonempty subsets of the four finite chains A_n={0,...,n-1} for n=1,2,3,4, with id_A the identity and each nonempty supremum computed as the maximum; the entire bounded space is swept in increasing n, subset size, and lexicographic order.
